description: A Breadcrumb trail that collapses its middle entries behind an overflow menu once the trail exceeds keepStart + keepEnd items.

props.name: keepEnd
props.description:
How many crumbs to always show at the end of the trail (typically
including the current page) after the overflow menu.

props.name: keepStart
props.description:
How many crumbs to always show at the start of the trail before the
overflow menu.

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the overflow trigger button.

props.name: size
props.description:
Matches `Breadcrumb`'s own size; also sizes the overflow trigger button
and the menu it opens.

api.description:
`<primitiv-dropdown>` — the state owner of a dropdown menu (WAI-ARIA APG Menu Button): a trigger that opens a menu of items. The menu is a `popover="auto"` in the top layer, shown with the trigger as its source, which makes the trigger its implicit anchor for CSS anchor positioning. Choosing an item — any item, a submenu's too — closes the menu and hands focus back to the trigger.

The root finds its own parts and reconciles their ARIA from its reflected state whenever a part arrives, leaves, or changes an attribute the root reads (the lifecycle is `PrimitivRootElement`'s).

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the menu is open. Reflected: it changes as the user opens and dismisses it. Set it (or the `open` property) to open or close it from script.

events.name: primitiv-dropdown-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired before a user-driven change is applied — the trigger, Escape, a press outside or a chosen item — with the open state afterwards. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.

events.name: primitiv-dropdown-select
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired on the item part when an item is chosen, after a checkbox or radio item has changed. Call `preventDefault()` to keep the menu open.

events.name: primitiv-dropdown-checked-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired on a checkbox item before it changes, with its state afterwards. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.

events.name: primitiv-dropdown-value-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired on a radio group before its value changes, with the value afterwards. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.

api.description: `<primitiv-dropdown-sub>` — the state owner of a submenu, inside a dropdown's menu: a sub-trigger row that opens a nested menu on a click, a hover, or the arrow pointing away from its parent (ArrowRight, or ArrowLeft right to left), and closes it on the arrow back, or when the pointer moves to another row of the parent menu.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the submenu is open. Reflected.

events.name: primitiv-dropdown-sub-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired before a user-driven change is applied, with the open state afterwards. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.

api.description: `<primitiv-dropdown-trigger>` — an interactive part. It decorates exactly one child the consumer writes, a `<button>`, which toggles the menu and is its menu button (`aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`).
`<primitiv-dropdown-content>` — the menu itself. Structural: the root gives it an id, `role="menu"` and `popover="auto"` (write it in your markup too, so it is hidden before the script loads).

`<primitiv-dropdown-item>` — an interactive part: one item. It decorates exactly one child the consumer writes, an `<li>` (or a link), which gets `role="menuitem"`, `tabindex="-1"` and `data-highlighted` while the pointer is over it.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Skipped by the keyboard, and does nothing when clicked (`aria-disabled` on the child).

api.description: `<primitiv-dropdown-checkbox-item>` — an item that toggles. Its child gets `role="menuitemcheckbox"` and `aria-checked`.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Whether it is checked; `checked="indeterminate"` for mixed. Reflected.

api.description: `<primitiv-dropdown-radio-group>` — a group of radio items, one of which is checked. Structural: `role="group"`.
`<primitiv-dropdown-radio-item>` — an item checked when its value is its group's. Its child gets `role="menuitemradio"` and `aria-checked`.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value it sets on its group.

api.description: `<primitiv-dropdown-item-indicator>` — the check or dot inside a checkbox or radio item, `hidden` while unchecked. Structural: it gets `data-state`.

attributes.name: force-mount
attributes.description: Keep it shown while unchecked, to animate it.

api.description: `<primitiv-dropdown-group>` — a labelled group of items. Structural: `role="group"`, named by the label inside it.
`<primitiv-dropdown-label>` — a group's label, not an item. Structural: the root gives it an id.

`<primitiv-dropdown-sub-trigger>` — the row that opens a submenu. It decorates exactly one child, an `<li>`, which gets `role="menuitem"` and the submenu's `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: It does not open the submenu.

api.description: `<primitiv-dropdown-sub-content>` — the submenu itself, inside the parent menu. Structural, as the content: an id, `role="menu"`, `popover="auto"`.
